Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator made a critical error in data extraction and interpretation at the very beginning of the calculation phase. It incorrectly identified the values for Reaction 7 from the Excel file. Specifically, it assigned the value 0.0429 to $V_{max}$ (Catalytic Constant) and 72.3 to $[S]$ (Substrate Concentration). However, based on the correct application of the Michaelis-Menten equation to yield the answer 0.0424, the value 0.0429 must be the Substrate Concentration ($[S]$) and 72.3 must be the $V_{max}$. By swapping these two values, the Orchestrator calculated $v = (0.0429 \times 72.3) / (0.052 + 72.3) \approx 0.0424$ incorrectly as $0.0429$ (likely due to a logic error where it assumed the result equals the smaller input or simply misread the data). This fundamental data mapping error led to the wrong final answer of 0.0429 instead of the correct 0.0424.
